verdict.rationale: Twilio Video's own docs describe recording compositions as "customized video layouts created from individual recordings," backed by a Compositions REST resource, Composition Hooks, and composition progress callbacks. That confirms a first-party feature for merging multi-participant recordings into one output. However, the pack contains no documentation of the actual layout options (grid, region, or positioning parameters); only a pricing-page mention of customized layouts. missing for 10: documented layout option parameters or a composition layout reference, examples of layout configuration, independent or hands-on corroboration of composition output.

support.subject: As a developer, multi-participant recordings can be composed into a single output with documented layout options

citations.quote: recording compositions (customized video layouts created from individual recordings) cost $0.01 per composed minute
Status Callbacks allow you to receive events related to the REST resources managed by Twilio: Rooms, Recordings, and Compositions.
When you create a Composition Hook, you can set the `StatusCallback` URL at such Hook.
Progress report for the media composition task, sent approximately every 10%.
